summary: Ticketplus Ltd., a Chilean company, filed a Form 6-K disclosing the partial exercise of the over-allotment option from its recent IPO. Roth Capital Partners, Bancroft Capital, and Public Ventures acted as representatives. The underwriters purchased an additional 258,814 Ordinary Shares at $8.00 per share, generating gross proceeds of approximately $2.07 million. The closing occurred on August 12, 2026. This is a routine follow-on transaction related to the IPO's greenshoe mechanism, not a special situation. What to watch: potential further exercises of the remaining over-allotment option.
